subject: ONE ancient tortoise with a wrinkled neck and round glasses, never held in one pose
second_characters: TWO crows hopping and flapping across the lens in EVERY beat; ONE mole gravedigger flinging dirt off his spade beside him

props.big: rows of grey headstones and crosses streaming past in EVERY beat; from 5.20 ONE empty old tortoise shell, hollow, lying on a grave mound
props.small: A SWARM of dry leaves and dirt clods tearing past the lens

environment: an old village cemetery on flat ground packed with headstones, crosses, iron fences and birches, no empty ground
lighting: hard midday daylight, bright sunny autumn, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the tortoise fills two thirds of its height in EVERY beat, his glasses and wrinkled face never under a quarter of it. He creeps along the row of graves at his own unhurried pace, neck swaying, front feet reaching, while the camera tracks sideways with him close and the headstones and crosses in the foreground stream past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat. Crows and leaves cross the lens in EVERY beat. A new shot size every beat, chest-up to very close. ONE big hero action per beat.

audio.delivery: dry creaky old male voice, musing, unhurried
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word by 5.20, then leaves and crows carry it
audio.lip_sync: face turned to the lens, mouth opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ya kap-LYU na PEN-si-yu TRI-sta LET, ba-YUS shto k VY-kha-du pri-DYOT-sya BRAT kre-DIT na GROB

timeline.line: Я коплю на пенсию триста лет.
timeline.a: chest-up, face turned to the lens, he creeps past a headstone, neck stretching forward, a crow hopping across the lens

timeline.line: Боюсь, что к выходу придется брать кредит на гроб.
timeline.a: he creeps on past crosses and pushes his head through a gap in an iron fence; at 3.70 the mole flings a spade of dirt across the lens, the tortoise ducks and shakes it off his glasses, both crows bursting up past the lens
he bumps his nose into ONE empty tortoise shell on a grave mound and peers inside it
he flips the empty shell over with his front feet, its hollow facing up like an open coffin
he climbs into the empty shell and lies down inside it on his back like in a coffin
he wriggles to fit and crosses his front feet on his chest, a crow landing on the rim
he rocks the shell side to side testing the fit, leaves pouring past the lens
the mole tosses a spade of dirt at his feet and the tortoise kicks it off and nods, satisfied
he pulls his head into his own shell and the empty shell rocks hard, both crows bursting off past the lens

must_appear: 0.00 the tortoise creeping past headstones, his glasses in frame; 5.20 ONE empty tortoise shell on a grave mound; 6.55 the tortoise lying inside the empty shell like in a coffin, front feet crossed on his chest
negative_prompt: printed text, cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a hero running, a conveyor belt, a cart, rails, a parked camera, a still or empty background, push in, wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, night, dark scene, fog, a hero back to the camera, a prop between his jaws, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 5.20, English speech, foreign accent, a second live tortoise, a wooden box, a funeral crowd
